---
title: "Site Map"
format: html
---

```{=html}
<div id="sitemap-meta" style="margin-bottom: 1rem; font-size: 0.95rem;"></div>
<div id="sitemap-network" style="height: 70vh; min-height: 520px; border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius: 10px;"></div>
<div id="sitemap-selected" style="margin-top: 1rem;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network@9.1.8/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>
<script>
(async function () {
  const meta = document.getElementById("sitemap-meta");
  const container = document.getElementById("sitemap-network");
  const selected = document.getElementById("sitemap-selected");

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/\"/g, "&quot;")
      .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch("files/site/sitemap-data.json", { cache: "no-store" });
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Unable to load sitemap-data.json (${res.status})`);
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    const nodes = data.nodes.map((n) => ({
      id: n.id,
      label: n.label,
      title:
        `<b>${escapeHtml(n.label)}</b><br>` +
        `Path: ${escapeHtml(n.path)}<br>` +
        `In links: ${n.indegree}<br>` +
        `Out links: ${n.outdegree}`,
      value: Math.max(1, n.degree),
      shape: "dot"
    }));

    const edges = data.edges.map((e) => ({
      from: e.source,
      to: e.target,
      arrows: "to",
      color: { color: "#8a8f98", opacity: 0.55 },
      width: 1.25,
      smooth: { enabled: true, type: "dynamic" }
    }));

    const network = new vis.Network(
      container,
      { nodes: new vis.DataSet(nodes), edges: new vis.DataSet(edges) },
      {
        autoResize: true,
        interaction: {
          hover: true,
          tooltipDelay: 100,
          navigationButtons: true,
          keyboard: true
        },
        physics: {
          stabilization: { iterations: 250 },
          barnesHut: { gravitationalConstant: -4800, springLength: 130, springConstant: 0.03 }
        },
        nodes: {
          borderWidth: 1,
          color: {
            border: "#1f2937",
            background: "#9ec5fe",
            highlight: { border: "#0f172a", background: "#f59e0b" }
          },
          scaling: {
            min: 8,
            max: 36,
            label: { enabled: true, min: 12, max: 24, drawThreshold: 8 }
          },
          font: { size: 12, face: "Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif", strokeWidth: 2, strokeColor: "#ffffff" }
        },
        edges: {
          selectionWidth: 2.5,
          hoverWidth: 2.2
        }
      }
    );

    meta.innerHTML = `<strong>Pages:</strong> ${data.nodeCount} | <strong>Internal links:</strong> ${data.edgeCount}`;

    network.on("click", (params) => {
      if (!params.nodes.length) {
        selected.innerHTML = "";
        return;
      }
      const id = params.nodes[0];
      const node = data.nodes.find((n) => n.id === id);
      if (!node) {
        selected.innerHTML = "";
        return;
      }

      selected.innerHTML =
        `<div style=\"padding:0.7rem 0.9rem;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;background:#f9fafb;\">` +
        `<strong>${escapeHtml(node.label)}</strong><br>` +
        `<a href=\"${escapeHtml(id)}\">Open page</a><br>` +
        `Path: ${escapeHtml(node.path)}<br>` +
        `Incoming links: ${node.indegree} | Outgoing links: ${node.outdegree}` +
        `</div>`;
    });
  } catch (err) {
    meta.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#b91c1c;">Sitemap data not available yet. Run a full site render to generate it.</span>`;
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:1rem;color:#374151;">${escapeHtml(err.message)}</div>`;
  }
})();
</script>
```
